FORMICA - a fan remake of SimAnt (1991)
=======================================

This is a test build. Thanks for trying it!

WHAT YOU NEED

  * A Windows 10 or 11 PC (64-bit).
  * Your own copy of the original DOS version of SimAnt. The remake does not include
    any of the original game: it reads the art, sounds and rules from your copy.
    The folder you need has these files in it:

        SIMANT.EXE   HCEGANT.DAT   HCEGANT.NDX   SHARED.DAT   SHARED.NDX   SOUND.DAT   SOUND.NDX

    (Only the first three are required. Without SHARED and SOUND there are no menus or sounds.)

STARTING THE GAME

  1. Right-click the zip you downloaded and choose "Extract All...", then open the
     extracted folder. (Running it straight from inside the zip won't work.)

  2. Double-click Formica.exe.

     Windows may show a blue box saying "Windows protected your PC". That happens because
     this test build isn't signed. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

  3. The first time, the game asks where your SimAnt files are. Click
     "Find my game folder..." and pick the folder with SIMANT.EXE in it (picking the folder
     just above it works too). The game remembers it, so you only do this once.

     Shortcut: if you copy your SimAnt files into the same folder as Formica.exe (or into a
     folder next to it), the game finds them by itself and skips this step.

PLAYING

  The screen works like the original game: the menus are along the top, and the game starts
  at the title screen. Click on the map to walk the yellow ant, double-click (or right-click)
  to pick up, drop, dig or fight. Press and hold on the yellow ant for its menu.

  Keyboard: Space pauses, + and - change the speed, arrow keys scroll, F follows the yellow ant.

  Saved games are kept in:  %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Formica
  (Paste that into the address bar of a File Explorer window to open it.)

IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG

  * "Find my game folder" says the files aren't there: make sure the folder really has
    SIMANT.EXE, HCEGANT.DAT and HCEGANT.NDX in it. The Windows version of SimAnt has
    different files and won't work; it has to be the DOS version.

  * To choose a different SimAnt folder, delete settings.cfg from the saved-games folder
    above and start the game again.

  * Anything else (a crash, something that looks wrong, something that doesn't work like
    the original): tell whoever sent you this, and say what you were doing when it happened.
    A screenshot helps a lot.
